name: Financing Agreement List 1
definition: Defines a list of party management registration and guarantee requests.

Identifier.name: Identifier
Identifier.definition: Identification assigned to unambiguously identify the agreement list.

AgreementResponder.name: Agreement Responder
AgreementResponder.definition: Party the agreement(s) are (to be) made with.

NotificationInformation.name: Notification Information
NotificationInformation.definition: Party or parties to notify and to acknowledge the agreement.

ItemCount.name: Item Count
ItemCount.definition: Number of individual items contained in the list.

ControlSum.name: Control Sum
ControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in the list, irrespective of currencies.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional proprietary formal information concerning the list.
